title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
summary: Researcher finds 35,000 Grok Build apps wide open to anyone who looked for them.
reason: Security/privacy incident report about Grok Build leaking confidential data. It announces no new model or capability (1-1), no research artifact (2-1), no financing/M&A/partnership/market data or product launch (3-1), no policy action (4-1), and no open-source tool release (5-1). No rule covers it.
